text: Your eyes are open now, nothing else yet.
Notice how tight your chest already is.
That tightness got here before the day did.
There's nothing here for you to fix.
Your phone can wait exactly where it is.
One hand can rest on your chest.
Feel it rise under your palm.
Feel it fall, slow and steady.
There's a warmth there, small and steady.
Like an ember that's been glowing all night.
Your jaw can soften while the day waits.
Your feet are still heavy against the sheets.
This moment isn't asking anything of you.
Whatever today brings, this glow is yours.
